cards.definition: A **set** is a collection of distinct objects treated as a single mathematical object. If an object $x$ belongs to a set $X$, write $x \in X$.
criteria: Describes a set as a collection of distinct objects.
Treats the collection as one mathematical object with well-defined membership.

cards.definition:
For sets $X$ and $Y$, their **Cartesian product** is the set of all ordered pairs whose first component is in $X$ and second component is in $Y$:

$$
X \times Y = \{(x,y) \mid x \in X,\ y \in Y\}.
$$
criteria: Identifies the elements as ordered pairs.
Requires the first component to come from X and the second from Y.

cards.definition:
A **binary relation** from $X$ to $Y$ is a subset of their Cartesian product:

$$
R \subseteq X \times Y.
$$

When $X=Y$, $R$ is called a relation on $X$.
criteria: Defines the relation as a subset of a Cartesian product.
Distinguishes a relation from X to Y from a relation on X.

cards.definition:
A relation $R$ on $X$ is **reflexive** when every element is related to itself:

$$
\forall x \in X,\quad xRx.
$$
criteria: Applies the condition to every element of the underlying set.
States that each element is related to itself.

cards.definition:
A relation $R$ on $X$ is **antisymmetric** when mutual relatedness forces equality:

$$
\forall x,y \in X,\quad (xRy \land yRx) \Rightarrow x=y.
$$
criteria: Applies the implication to every pair of elements.
States that xRy and yRx together imply x equals y.

cards.definition:
A relation $R$ on $X$ is **transitive** when every two-step relation chain closes:

$$
\forall x,y,z \in X,\quad (xRy \land yRz) \Rightarrow xRz.
$$
criteria: Applies the implication to every triple of elements.
States that xRy and yRz together imply xRz.

cards.definition:
A **partial order** on $X$ is a binary relation on $X$ that is:

- **reflexive**: $xRx$ for every $x \in X$;
- **antisymmetric**: $xRy$ and $yRx$ imply $x=y$; and
- **transitive**: $xRy$ and $yRz$ imply $xRz$.
criteria: Identifies a partial order as a binary relation on a set.

cards.definition:
A **total order** is a partial order in which every pair of elements is comparable:

$$
\forall x,y \in X,\quad xRy \lor yRx.
$$
criteria: Retains all defining requirements of a partial order.
Requires every pair of elements to be comparable.
